---
title: "rtfreporter: Development Summary Report"
params:
  out: "out"
output: pdf_document
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
out <- params$out
rd <- function(f) if (file.exists(file.path(out, f))) readRDS(file.path(out, f))
csv <- function(f) if (file.exists(file.path(out, f))) {
  utils::read.csv(file.path(out, f), colClasses = "character", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
chk <- rd("check.rds")
tests <- rd("tests.rds")
cov <- rd("coverage.rds")
envs <- rd("environments.rds")
local_runs <- csv("local-runs.csv")
tr <- csv("traceability.csv")
ft <- csv("ft.csv")
fres <- csv("test-results.csv")
fn_tab <- csv("functions.csv")
# the leaves carry the tests; a parent's coverage is its leaves'
leaf <- !tr$fr %in% tr$parent
tl <- tr[leaf, , drop = FALSE]
# an FR met: it has FTs, and they all pass
fr_ok <- vapply(tl$fr, function(id) {
  f <- ft$ft[vapply(strsplit(ft$fr, " ", fixed = TRUE), function(x) id %in% x, NA)]
  r <- fres$result[fres$ft %in% f]
  length(r) > 0L && !any(r %in% c("fail", "not run"))
}, NA)
ver <- as.character(utils::packageVersion("rtfreporter"))
commit <- tryCatch(system2("git", c("rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD"), stdout = TRUE),
                   error = function(e) "unknown")
n_fail <- if (!is.null(tests)) sum(tests$failed > 0 | tests$error) else NA
# the exported functions a test runs (covtracer), and those it runs directly
fn <- cov$fn_tests
run_by_test <- if (!is.null(fn)) unique(fn$alias) else character()
direct <- if (!is.null(fn) && any(!is.na(fn$direct))) unique(fn$alias[fn$direct %in% TRUE]) else
  character()
not_run <- setdiff(cov$exports, run_by_test)
```

Version `r ver` (commit `r commit`), `r format(Sys.Date())`.
Environment: `r R.version.string`; `r utils::sessionInfo()$running`.
```{r links, results = "asis"}
# (the details are GitHub's: the run that made this report, the release)
gh <- Sys.getenv(c("GITHUB_SERVER_URL", "GITHUB_REPOSITORY", "GITHUB_RUN_ID", "GITHUB_REF_NAME"))
if (all(nzchar(gh[1:3]))) {
  cat(sprintf("Run: <%s/%s/actions/runs/%s>; releases: <%s/%s/releases>.\n",
              gh[1], gh[2], gh[3], gh[1], gh[2]))
}
```

## Scope

The package's functional requirements (FR, `inst/validation/requirements.csv`) and the
functional tests that check them (FT, the test blocks; `inst/validation/test_map.csv`),
`r nrow(tl)` FRs (leaves) in this release's scope.  The traceability matrix FR -> FT is the
record of what is tested; the automatic report below (tests, coverage, the tests that run
each exported function, R CMD check) is its evidence that every exported function runs
under the tests.

## Results

| Measure | Value |
|---|---|
| FRs with at least one FT | `r sum(as.integer(tl$n_ft) > 0)` of `r nrow(tl)` |
| Guard FRs (unintended use stopped) with an FT | `r sum(as.integer(tl$n_ft) > 0 & tl$kind == "guard")` of `r sum(tl$kind == "guard")` |
| FRs whose FTs all pass | `r sum(fr_ok)` of `r nrow(tl)` |
| Upper FRs covered / partial / none | `r sum(tr$coverage[!leaf] == "covered")` / `r sum(tr$coverage[!leaf] == "partial")` / `r sum(tr$coverage[!leaf] == "none")` |
| Functional tests (FT) | `r nrow(ft)`: `r sum(fres$result == "pass")` pass, `r sum(fres$result == "fail")` fail, `r sum(fres$result == "skip")` skip |
| All tests (test blocks; expectations) | `r if (!is.null(tests)) nrow(tests) else NA`; `r if (!is.null(tests)) sum(tests$expectations) else NA`, `r n_fail` failing blocks |
| Line coverage | `r if (!is.null(cov)) sprintf("%.1f%%", cov$total) else NA` |
| Exported functions run by a test | `r length(intersect(cov$exports, run_by_test))` of `r length(cov$exports)` |
| Exported functions a test calls directly | `r if (length(direct)) length(intersect(cov$exports, direct)) else "not recorded"` |
| R-CMD-check of this commit on CI | `r if (!is.null(envs) && nrow(envs)) sprintf("%d of %d environments succeed (attachment G)", sum(envs$result == "success"), nrow(envs)) else "not found"` |
| R CMD check (`--as-cran`) | `r if (!is.null(chk)) sprintf("%d errors, %d warnings, %d notes", length(chk$errors), length(chk$warnings), length(chk$notes)) else "not run"` |

## Deviations

```{r deviations, results = "asis"}
dev <- c(
  if (!all(fr_ok)) sprintf("- %s (%s): no passing test", tl$fr[!fr_ok], tl$kind[!fr_ok]),
  if (isTRUE(n_fail > 0)) sprintf("- %d test blocks fail.", n_fail),
  if (length(not_run)) sprintf("- Exported functions no test runs: %s.", paste(not_run, collapse = ", ")),
  if (!is.null(chk) && length(chk$errors)) "- R CMD check has errors.",
  if (!is.null(envs) && any(envs$result != "success")) sprintf("- R-CMD-check on %s: %s.",
    envs$environment[envs$result != "success"], envs$result[envs$result != "success"]),
  if (!is.null(chk) && length(chk$warnings)) "- R CMD check has warnings.")
cat(if (length(dev)) dev else "None.", sep = "\n")
```

## Conclusion

```{r conclusion, results = "asis"}
ok <- all(fr_ok) && isTRUE(n_fail == 0) &&
  (is.null(chk) || !length(chk$errors))
cat(if (ok) {
  "Every functional requirement in scope is checked by tests that pass, and the package passes R CMD check without errors."
} else {
  "Not every criterion is met: see the deviations."
})
```

\newpage

# Attachments

## A. Traceability matrix: FR -> FT

```{r attach-a}
knitr::kable(tr[, c("fr", "parent", "kind", "functions", "n_ft", "coverage")],
             col.names = c("FR", "Parent", "Kind", "Functions", "FTs", "Coverage"))
```

The FT ids of each FR are in `traceability.csv`, each FT's file and test in `ft.csv`; the
tests' results are apart, in `test-results.csv` and the CI's test record.  A failing test
fails the pull request's checks, so it cannot be merged.

## B. R CMD check

```{r attach-b, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(chk)) cat("Not run.") else {
  cat(sprintf("Status %s; %d errors, %d warnings, %d notes.\n\n", chk$status,
              length(chk$errors), length(chk$warnings), length(chk$notes)))
  for (x in c(chk$errors, chk$warnings, chk$notes)) cat("```\n", x, "\n```\n\n")
}
```

## C. Test results by file

```{r attach-c}
if (!is.null(tests)) {
  by <- aggregate(cbind(blocks = 1, expectations = expectations, failed = as.integer(failed > 0 | error),
                        skipped = as.integer(skipped)) ~ file, data = tests, sum)
  knitr::kable(by, col.names = c("File", "Blocks", "Expectations", "Failed", "Skipped"))
}
```

## D. Line coverage by file

```{r attach-d}
if (!is.null(cov)) knitr::kable(cov$files[order(cov$files$file), ],
                                col.names = c("File", "Lines", "Covered", "%"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## E. Exported functions and the tests that run them

```{r attach-e}
if (!is.null(fn)) {
  n <- table(factor(fn$alias, levels = cov$exports))
  knitr::kable(data.frame(Function = names(n), Tests = as.integer(n),
                          Direct = if (length(direct)) ifelse(names(n) %in% direct, "yes", "") else ""),
               row.names = FALSE)
}
```

## F. Environment

```{r attach-f, comment = ""}
if (file.exists(file.path(out, "session.txt"))) cat(readLines(file.path(out, "session.txt")), sep = "\n")
```

## G. R-CMD-check of this commit, every CI environment

```{r attach-g, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(envs) || !nrow(envs)) {
  cat("No R-CMD-check run was found for this commit.")
} else {
  print(knitr::kable(data.frame(Environment = envs$environment, Result = envs$result,
                                Tests = envs$tests, Run = sprintf("<%s>", envs$url)),
                     row.names = FALSE))
}
```

```{r attach-h, results = "asis"}
if (!is.null(local_runs)) {
  cat("\n## H. Local runs (by hand)\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(local_runs, row.names = FALSE))
}
```
